subject: English
question_text: Choose the best answer from the alternatives.
stimulus: ⎯ a. Man can control the effect of the greenhouse gases on . (i) the atmosphere (ii) the moon (iii) the sun (iv) human being ⎯ b. Enormous areas of forests are destroyed . (i) weekly (ii) daily (iii) yearly (iv) monthly ⎯ c. At present about barrels of crude oil are used daily. (i) 8.5 million (ii) 850 lakh (iii) 850 million (iv) 85 lakh ⎯ d. Greenhouse gases are being produced all over the world by (i) human beings (ii) plants (iii) animals (iv) nature ⎯ e. A fossil raw material which is burned releases carbon dioxide into the . (i) air (ii) soil (iii) oil (iv) water ⎯ f. Industrial activities are giving rise to . (i) many factories (ii) houses (iii) buildings (iv) factories ⎯ g. Industrial factories require . (i) air (ii) fire (iii) coal (iv) water Extra Practices h. The greenhouse effect is strengthened by ⎯. (i) forestation (ii) deforestation (iii) planting trees (iv) using pesticides ⎯ i. Forests are destroyed every year by . (i) animals (ii) people (iii) goats and cows (iv) forest officers ⎯ j. Factories produce energy through the combustion of . (i) trees (ii) plants (iii) straw (iv) coal
guide_solution: a. (i) the atmosphere; b. (iii) yearly; c. (ii) 850 lakh; d. (i) human beings; e. (i) air; f. (i) many factories; g. (ii) the air; h. (ii) deforestation; i. (ii) people; j. (iv) coal.

subject: English
stimulus: a. What’s the main cause of the increase in carbon dioxide level in the atmosphere? b. What can a man control? c. How the greenhouse effect is strengthened? d. How many barrels of crude oil are used daily nowadays? e. How do the factories produce energy? Extra Practices f. What other purposes are coal and other sources of energy burned in? g. By whom are more greenhouse gases generated worldwide? h. What is deforestation? i. Why do people destroy forests? j. Why is the carbon dioxide storehouse destroyed with the forests? ✕
guide_solution: a. The main cause of the increase in carbon dioxide level in the atmosphere is the burning of fossil fuels. b. Man can control the increase in the amount of greenhouse gases and its effect on the atmosphere. c. The greenhouse effect is strengthened by deforestation. d. About 85 million barrels of crude oil are used daily nowadays. e. The factories produce energy through the combustion of coal. f. Coal and other sources of energy are burned to heat houses, move cars and airplanes or to produce electricity. g. More and more greenhouse gases are generated worldwide by humans. h. Deforestation means cutting down trees. i. People destroy forests to get wood and to clear regions for mining and to create pasture. j. The carbon dioxide storehouse is destroyed with the forests as they absorb a lot of carbon dioxide from the air and deliver oxygen instead.
